_doc: Deterministic fast paths (intents.go). Patterns are full-match, case-insensitive, run on the request with accents, trailing punctuation and polite words removed. {{test}} {{build}} {{lint}} {{fmt}} come from project detection, {{git}} is 'git' inside a repository, {{search}} is rg or grep; an empty variable means the intent does not apply. {{slot}} is a named group, checked against slots[slot] and shell-quoted. Override in ~/.config/jazz-cli/intents.json or .jazz/intents.json (same name replaces, "disabled": true removes).

intents.name: test
patterns: (?:rode|roda|rodar|rode ai|roda ai|execute|executa|executar|run|rerun|re-run)(?: (?:os|todos os|the|all|all the))? (?:testes|teste|tests|test|test suite|suite de testes|a suite de testes)(?: (?:de novo|novamente|again|agora|now))?
(?:testa|testar|testa ai|testa tudo|testar tudo|test everything|test it)

intents.name: build
patterns: (?:rode|roda|rodar|execute|executa|run|faz|faca|fazer|faz ai)(?: o| a| the)? (?:build|compilacao)
(?:compile|compila|compilar|compila ai|builda|buildar|build)(?: (?:o projeto|tudo|the project|it|everything))?

intents.name: lint
patterns: (?:rode|roda|rodar|run|execute|executa)(?: o| os| the)? (?:lint|linter|linters|vet)
(?:lint|linta|lintar)(?: (?:o projeto|tudo|the project|it|everything))?

intents.name: fmt
patterns: (?:checa|checar|verifica|verificar|check)(?: a| o| the)? (?:formatacao|formatting|format|fmt)

qual (?:o|e o) status(?: do git| do repo| do repositorio)?

patterns: (?:qual|qual e|qual foi|quem fez|quando foi)(?: o)? ultimo commit|(?:o )?ultimo commit|(?:mostra|mostre|me mostra|ver)(?: o)? ultimo commit
